name: operand-compilation-test-fbca3afc7e/successful-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
Expressions: Literal — Currently support nil-literal, boolean-literal, numeric-literal and string-literal only

Invocations / Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The parameter declarations and literal defaults are supported, but the @args directive makes successful command-line operand binding essential: strings must populate int, float, decimal and string main parameters, with omitted nullable operands and defaultable parameters accepted. Subset 10 documents function signatures and function-call defaults but does not cover command-line main operand conversion or omission behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line operand binding/conversion for typed main parameters, including omitted nullable operands and defaultable parameters
test_design_notes: The empty body has no value assertions; the observable assertion is successful startup with the four supplied command-line arguments.
